cases.constructed: Authenticated adult claims guardianship without valid appointment
cases.proposed_evidence: Department must distinguish identity evidence from proof of legal relationship, current authority and subject consent where required. Test missing, forged and mismatched appointment evidence; automated workflow checks do not authenticate underlying documents.

cases.constructed: Valid guardian attempts credential deletion or presentation outside permitted scope
cases.proposed_evidence: Exercise allowed and denied operations, check actor/subject separation and distinct audit entries. Inspect Department scope policy and enforcement; presentation authority does not by itself authorize deletion or revocation.

cases.constructed: Previously authorized guardian presents after expiry or termination
cases.proposed_evidence: Check termination evidence and status freshness at wallet and verifier/relying party, including offline paths; establish who can terminate authority and acceptable propagation bounds. Do not conflate guardian termination with subject credential revocation.
cases.authority: Department, Wallet Providers, Verifiers, Relying Parties

cases.constructed: Authorized guardian supports a subject who can express preferences, but service requires guardian to act as if subject consent were unnecessary
cases.proposed_evidence: Exercise subject consent where required, supported versus substituted decision-making and equivalent service terms. Check relationship-specific legal basis, accessible interaction and actual processing outcomes; do not presume all subjects lack capacity.

cases.constructed: Technically authorized guardian uses identity attributes for personal benefit at subject's expense
cases.proposed_evidence: Distinguish scope enforcement from best-interest judgment. Inspect participant duties, accessible complaint routes, independent conflict review and remediation; clarify LOY-05 role-table omission. No conclusion that harm occurred.
cases.authority: Digital Guardians, Department and competent oversight authorities

cases.constructed: Valid guardian presentation receives equivalent service in a bounded fixture
cases.proposed_evidence: Positive fixture must use valid relationship, current authority and appropriate consent; measure equivalent service and preserve attribution. A single fixture does not establish all guardianship relationships or actual service parity.
cases.authority: Department, Wallet Providers, Verifiers, Relying Parties
